title: workspace project add
description: Stdout of `workspace project add --path DIR --json`: the checkout DIR is added to the workspace as a project (or bound to the project its marker names), and its marker is written when it had none. Same document as `project attach`. Nothing is committed.

created.description: Whether this call created the project record in the workspace.

marker_written.description: Whether this call wrote the marker into the checkout.

plans_store.description: Where the plans live: in the checkout (legacy) or in the workspace.

binding.description: The checkouts of the project on this machine after the call.

next.description: The command that commits the marker; present only when the marker was written.
